headline: Single-cell and long-read assays resolve cell-type-specific regulatory states
label: Cell Type Resolved Regulatory Profiling
summary: Joint single-cell readouts of histone marks, Cas9 edits and methylation now link regulatory state to expression within defined cell types.
synthesis: None of the four items presents a sequence-to-activity variant-effect model; the shared thread is experimental, cell-type-resolved measurement of regulatory state. Superb-seq jointly captures Cas9 edits and single-cell transcriptomes in K562, linking on- and off-target edits to expression changes. TrES-seq pairs scRNA-seq with nanobody-Tn5 profiling of H3K27ac, H3K27me3 and H3K9me3, relating epigenetic and transcriptional axes within individual cells. COMET assigns individual bulk long reads to cell types using cell-type-specific methylation across human tissues. A single-cell lncRNA atlas of more than 370,000 cells across 18 cancer types connects lncRNAs to regulons, CRISPR screens and survival. What is new is the pairing of perturbation or regulatory readouts with cell identity; such context-specific data could serve as benchmarks for regulatory variant predictors, though none of these items tests that use directly.
